title: 3.2.6 Project — Solar System
description: Build a complete Solar System: sun + earth + moon orbiting via frameCount-driven Math.sin/cos, black space background, color differentiation per body, plus a 4th body of your own choice.

steps.title: Create the sun
steps.instructions: In setup(), create `sun = new Sphere(0, 0, 0, 1.2)` and set it to yellow.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and find the Sphere section.

steps.title: Create the earth
steps.instructions: In setup(), create `earth = new Sphere(4, 0, 0, 0.6)` offset from the sun and set it to blue.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and find the Sphere section.

steps.title: Create the moon
steps.instructions: In setup(), create `moon = new Sphere(5.2, 0, 0, 0.3)` near earth and set it to gray.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and find the Sphere section.

steps.title: Orbit earth around the sun
steps.instructions: In draw(), set `earth.position.x = Math.cos(radians(frameCount * 0.6)) * 4` and `earth.position.z = Math.sin(radians(frameCount * 0.6)) * 4`.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and review the radians() helper and the B0 anchor reading.

steps.title: Orbit moon around earth
steps.instructions: In draw(), use the anchor offset: `moon.position.x = earth.position.x + Math.cos(radians(frameCount * 2)) * 1.2` and the matching z.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer — the anchor pattern is: child = parent.position + offset.

steps.title: Spin the sun
steps.instructions: In draw(), add `sun.rotation.y += 0.005` so the sun slowly rotates.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and check the rotation property.

steps.title: Add a 4th orbiting body
steps.instructions: Create a 4th Sphere (Mars, Jupiter, a comet — your choice). Assign it to `myPlanet`, give it a unique color, orbit radius, and speed. Document it with a `// my planet:` comment.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and find the Sphere section. Choose your own orbit speed (frameCount multiplier) and radius.

requirements.title: At least 3 Spheres present
requirements.description: new Sphere() appears at least 3 times (sun, earth, moon minimum).

requirements.title: 4th body is documented
requirements.description: myPlanet variable or a '// my planet' comment is present.

requirements.title: radians() is used
requirements.description: The radians() helper appears in the orbit math.

requirements.title: Orbit math on at least one body
requirements.description: position.x is set using Math.cos or Math.sin.

requirements.title: Anchor offset used for moon
requirements.description: Moon orbit uses earth's position as an anchor.

requirements.title: 4th body orbits independently
requirements.description: A 4th Sphere is created and given its own orbit (position.x or position.z updated in draw()).
